cwe_content.cwe: CWE-79,Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

candidate.Reason: The 'ref' parameter is directly set as a request attribute without sanitization, which can be reflected in the web page and lead to XSS if not properly escaped in the view.
